items.q: Uromodulin (Tamm-Horsfall protein) is produced by the:
opts: Thick ascending limb of loop of Henle
items.exp: Produced by thick ascending limb of loop of Henle. (Book p744)

items.q: The daily excretion of uromodulin quoted is:
Which statement about uromodulin is TRUE?
opts: It is the most abundant component of normal urine and forms the matrix of casts
It is the most abundant component of normal plasma
It dissolves cast matrices in alkaline urine
It is excreted only in glomerular disease
items.exp: Most abundant component of normal urine; forms matrix of casts. (Book p744)

items.q: Match each urine protein range (mg/day) with its label — 1) <150 2) 150-500 3) >500 … A) Significant proteinuria B) Normal C) Functional proteinuria
items.exp: <150 normal; 150-500 functional proteinuria; >500 significant proteinuria. (Book p744)

items.q: An anxious student presents before exams with urine protein of 300 mg/day. The book's category for this level is:
items.exp: 150-500 mg/day: functional proteinuria (stress, anxiety, menses, protein supplements). (Book p744)

items.q: Fill up: In pregnancy, significant proteinuria is defined as urine protein greater than ______ mg/day.
items.exp: >300 mg/day: significant proteinuria in pregnancy (vs >500 otherwise). (Book p744)
